Football Italia Live Blog
Join us for all the build-up and action as it happens from today’s five Serie A games: Inter-Fiorentina, Genoa-Venezia, Atalanta-Frosinone, Lecce-Juventus, and Udinese-Milan.
We begin at 12:30 CET [11:30 GMT] with Inter hosting Fiorentina at San Siro.
The Nerazzurri need a win to catch Lazio at the top of the Serie A table after Gennaro Gattuso’s side beat Parma 2-1 on Saturday.
The afternoon games, both starting at 15:00 CET, are Genoa-Venezia and Atalanta-Frosinone.
Only one point separates Venezia and Genoa after the Lagunari won their first match under Davide Nicola last week. Venezia remain bottom of the league with three points, but Parma, Fiorentina, Genoa and Udinese are just one point above them.
Juventus visit Eusebio Di Francesco’s Lecce at 18:00 CET, and Serie A Week 8 ends at 20:45 with Milan’s away game at Udinese.
Juventus have earned just five points in their last five Serie A matches, with two draws, two defeats, and one win.
Milan, on the other hand, remain unbeaten in Serie A but have managed just two wins and three draws in their last five.

“It’s a difficult match for the characteristics of our opponents. We need a lot of determination, but also cool heads,” Sarri told DAZN.
“We expect a lot from De Ketelaere, who has immense potential. We keep putting confidence in him, but he also needs to respond.”
This is a pure relegation dogfight at Marassi. The Grifone seemed to turn a corner with their 2-1 win over Fiorentina before the 2-0 loss at Roma. Kingsley Ehizibue, Djibril Sow and Lorenzo Venturino miss out, with Lorenzo Colombo and Amorim not at 100 per cent.
Davide Nicola made the perfect debut on the Lagunari bench, beating Napoli 1-0 for the team’s first points of the season. Thierry Correia, Andrea Adorante, Marin Sverko and Bartol Franjic are still injured.
Genoa: Bijlow; Otoa, Ostigard, Vasquez; Ellertsson, Traoré, Wiafe, Mitaj; Messias, El Shaarawy; Osmajic
Venezia: Stankovic; Halhal, Moreno, Juan Jesus; Hainaut, Kike Perez, Sohm, Basic, Haps; Adams, Yeboah
La Dea continue to stutter this season, losing four of their last five Serie A matches, and fresh from Thursday’s 2-0 Conference League defeat to Ajax. The injury crisis intensified, missing Sead Kolasinac, Giorgio Scalvini, Isak Hien, Odilon Kossounou, Franck Kessie, Giacomo Raspadori and Kamaldeen Sulemana.
The Canarini have been one of the big surprises since promotion from Serie B, amassing 13 points in six rounds, losing only to Napoli in that spell. Florian Grillitsch is the only absentee, though Ilario Monterisi and Gabriele Calvani are not at 100 per cent.
Atalanta: Carnesecchi; Bellanova, Kristensen, Obric, Zappacosta; Gaetano, Ederson; Elmas, De Ketelaere, Rowe; Krstovic
Frosinone: Palmisani; Oyono, Calvani, Cittadini, Bracaglia; Calò, Masini; Ghedjemis, Schmid, Kvernadze; Raimondo

FINAL WHISTLE!
What a game, Inter completed another comeback! Full match report out soon.
Goal kick for Fiorentina, one final long pass.
Inter try to keep the ball in their attacking third.
Two more minutes of added time!
Zielinski!
De Gea dives the right way, but Zielinski’s effort flies into the top corner, leaving him with no chance! Inter take the lead, and that could be game over!
There’s confusion on the pitch now; Fiorentina are protesting, but Zielinski is ready to take the penalty.
A cross comes in from the left, Valdepeñas grabs Thuram’s shirt and pulls him down at the far post. The referee immediately points to the spot.
Weak Dimarco shot, De Gea saves it.
Thuram!
The Frenchman links up with compatriot Diouf on the edge of the box, then sends a slow but perfectly placed shot past De Gea.
Inter have made 26 total shots so far, DAZN says.
De Gea denies Sucic! Another brilliant intervention.
Good chance for Thuram: he shoots from a decent position inside the box, but the shot lacks quality and goes over the crossbar.
Beto is Fiorentina’s most advanced player, but struggles to get on the ball for counter-attacks. Inter, on the other hand, are sending Bisseck inside the box to join the attackers.
Now it’s just about Inter trying to find space down the flanks and through the middle. Fiorentina defend with ten men behind the ball. Four minutes to go plus added time.
Inter substitution
Out: Barella
In: Lavelli
Second Inter appearance for the 19-year-old striker.
Fiorentina go with a back three now, Dodo as right midfielder, and Joao Mario on the left. Gnonto and Beto up front.
Fiorentina substitutions.
